query.user: I am leaving Cambridge and need to go to Broxbourne on Friday .
query.Thought: The user wants to find trains from Cambridge to Broxbourne departing on Friday. I need to call the SearchTrain API to find available trains.
query.assistant: : There are 19 trains for Friday that fit your needs, would you like to narrow that down with a time you would like to depart?

query.user: I need to arrive by 18:15 please .
query.Thought: The user specified a desired arrival time of 18:15. I need to call the SearchTrain API again with the new constraint to find trains that arrive by that time.
query.assistant: : The first one arrives at 10:01, how many tickets please?

query.user: I also want a cheap hotel with star 0 in north.
query.Thought: The user is inquiring about the area of town for the earlier mentioned train destination or for accommodations. Based on the previous hotel search, it seems the user is referring to hotel locations, so I need to call the searchHotel API to retrieve the location information for the hotels mentioned.
query.assistant: : City Center B&B is located in the north and El Shaddai is located in the centre.

function.name: SearchTrain
function.description: Searches for train information including pricing, schedules, and duration.

departure.description: Starting location of the train journey

destination.description: Final destination of the train journey

return_info.description: List of details to be returned in response, with options such as 'all', 'trainID', 'Ticket' (price), 'ArriveBy', 'leaveAt'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.

day.description: The date for the train search

leaveAt.description: Desired time of departure (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

arriveBy.description: Desired time of arrival (requires either leaveAt or arriveBy)

function.name: BookTrain
function.description: Enables users to book train tickets.

people.description: Number of passengers for the booking

trainID.description: The identifier of the train to be booked

return_info.description: Details that the user will receive after booking, including options like 'all', 'isSuccess', 'reference', 'Ticket'. If the user does not specify what information is needed, select 'all'; otherwise, fill in the corresponding name.

function.name: searchHotel
function.description: To search for hotels based on a set of criteria including rating, type, amenities, location, and price range.

stars.description: The hotel rating based on stars.

parking.description: Availability of parking at the hotel.

internet.description: Availability of internet service at the hotel.

area.description: The location area of the hotel.

priceRange.description: The price range of the hotel.

return_info.description: A list specifying the fields to be returned.

function.name: bookHotel
function.description: To book hotels by providing booking date, hotel name, duration of stay, number of people, and specifying fields to be returned.

name.description: The hotel name for the booking.

stay.description: The number of days to stay at the hotel.

people.description: The number of people for the booking.

return_info.description: Fields to be returned after booking.
